notes.title: Fantôme Launch Fix Update!
notes.notes:
Dear Fantôme Community,

We're excited to bring you a significant launch fix update, making Fantôme more accessible based on your valuable feedback! 🚀 We have worked tirelessly to enhance stability, ensuring a smoother multiplayer experience and addressing concerns raised by our players.

Your continued support has been the driving force behind Fantôme's evolution, and we're committed to delivering an unforgettable gaming experience. Stay tuned for more updates as we venture into this new chapter together!

Thank you for being a part of the Fantôme community. Get ready for the next level of horror!

Sincerely,
Gloac Games

notes.title: 🌟 Exciting News! Fantôme Release Date Reveal 🌟
notes.notes:
Dear Fantôme Community,

As we step into the new year of 2024, we're thrilled to announce that Fantôme is set to launch on January 18th! 🚀 This marks the culmination of our collective journey, and your unwavering support has been our driving force.

The development team has poured heart and soul into every detail, ensuring an immersive and spine-chilling experience for all players. Your feedback, dedication, and patience have fueled this journey, and we're immensely grateful.

This final update represents the culmination of our efforts. We've fine-tuned, polished, and added new elements to make Fantôme an unforgettable horror adventure. Thank you for staying with us on this thrilling ride.

Get ready to step into the abyss on January 18th, 2024. Your journey into the darkness awaits! 🌑

As we embark on this new year, we extend warm New Year's greetings to you and your loved ones. Know that our commitment to providing you with updates, both before and after the launch, remains unwavering. We're eager to continue this adventure together.

With sincere appreciation,

Gloac Games

notes.title: Procedural Bosses Unleashed in 'School' Level Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Fearless Explorers!

We're thrilled to present our latest major update, amplifying the horror in our 'School' level.

In a spine-tingling twist, we've unleashed not one, but two procedural bosses to haunt your every step. The dreaded Undead Boss now shares the stage with a new, mysterious adversary. Who will you face in your quest for survival? The choice is yours, and the stakes are higher than ever.

But that's not all – we've also addressed lagging bugs to ensure that your journey through the 'School' level is as smooth as it is terrifying. Your immersive experience is our priority.

As a special treat, here's a glimpse of the ominous boss level that awaits you:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42673810/66c71af105aad3bba4d2f4aac05895bfaa339670.jpg[/img]

Dive into the chilling unknown and see if you can conquer the horrors that lurk within. Happy gaming and may your courage prevail in the face of the malevolent!

notes.title: New 'School' Map & Lag Fixes Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Fearless Explorers!

We're thrilled to unveil our latest major update, introducing the haunting 'School' map. Step into the eerie corridors of a long-forgotten educational institution, where mysteries and terrors await. But that's not all – we've also addressed nagging lag issues that some players faced, ensuring a smoother and more immersive experience.

As you delve into the chilling atmosphere of the 'School' map, prepare to uncover secrets, face relentless challenges, and test your wits against the unknown. With updated gameplay mechanics and a more seamless environment, you'll find yourself fully immersed in the world of horror.

And as a special treat, here are two screenshots to give you a sneak peek into the darkness that awaits. Get ready for an unforgettable journey!

notes.title: Optional Objectives & Crying Souls Hunt Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Fearless Seekers!

In this major update, we're introducing a game-changing feature. Now, when you hit the escape button to open the pause menu, you'll uncover a world of hidden objectives waiting to be tackled. As part of this update, we're adding a gripping optional objective: search for the lost crying souls hidden in the chilling woods. Completing this task will banish one of the guarding ghosts from the dark relics, altering the very fabric of your haunting experience. Dive in, embrace the challenge, and rewrite the rules of terror. Happy hunting!

notes.title: JumpScares and AI Improvements Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Fearless Explorers!

In this thrilling update, we're unleashing a wave of terror with brand new Jump Scares that will keep you on the edge of your seat. But that's not all—our relentless Madman has sharpened his instincts with enhanced follow path AI. Brace yourselves for a heart-pounding journey through the darkness, where every step may be your last. Will you emerge unscathed, or succumb to the horrors that await? Dive in and find out, if you dare.

notes.title: Language and Audio Fixes Update
notes.notes: Hello, dear Fantôme players! We're thrilled to introduce this significant update to enhance your gaming experience in Fantôme. With your feedback in mind, we've diligently addressed language issues and audio glitches, ensuring smoother gameplay and improved immersion. Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy this improved version of Fantôme!

notes.title: Unleashing Terror: The Rajbari Boss Update
notes.notes:
Venture deeper into the heart of darkness with our Rajbari Boss Update, a monumental addition to the Fantôme experience. Prepare for an unprecedented level of terror as you face a nightmarish new boss lurking within the haunted confines of Rajbari.

The Rajbari level has undergone a spine-tingling transformation, filled with macabre surprises and relentless challenges. As you traverse its eerie corridors, you'll discover the malevolent force that has taken residence here.

This update is a testament to our commitment to delivering the most immersive and fear-inducing horror experience possible. We've carefully crafted every detail, from the boss's horrifying design to the hair-raising encounters you'll endure.

Are you ready to confront the unimaginable? Explore Rajbari, outsmart the malevolent presence, and emerge victorious in the face of unrelenting terror. Your journey through Fantôme has just become even more perilous and unforgettable.

Thank you for being a part of our Fantôme community. The nightmare has only just begun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42673810/6283b421163e9d982ebc56da4ef1ebd682f31112.png[/img]

notes.title: Hint & Bug Fix Update
notes.notes:
Hi, Fearless Explorers!

We want to express our deepest thanks for your unwavering support. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we're excited to bring you the latest Fantôme update.

Update Highlights:

[list][*]Hints Enabled: Navigate the horrors with ease as we introduce the long-awaited hint enable option. Unravel the mysteries of Fantôme like never before.[/list]

[list][*]Bug Fixes: We've been hard at work exorcising bugs, ensuring a smoother and more immersive gameplay experience. Say goodbye to pesky colliders and erratic footsteps.[/list]

[list][*]Sneak Peek: Get a tantalizing glimpse of our another work-in-progress boss room. Brace yourself for an even more heart-pounding encounter in the depths of Fantôme.[/list]

Once again, thank you for being a part of our Fantôme community. Your support fuels our journey into the unknown. Dive back into the terror, and let's conquer it together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42673810/7cada71c8d417a80711f8cc2be04b01a909e632b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The Countdown Begins: Fantôme, Update on the Horizon!
notes.notes:
Hello Fantôme Community,

We want to apologize for our prolonged silence since our last update on August 19, 2022. Internal challenges prevented us from communicating, and we deeply regret any frustration this caused.

We're thrilled to announce that during this time, we've been hard at work redeveloping Fantôme. Our focus has shifted towards enhancing the player experience by introducing single-player gameplay and LAN functionality.

We're excited to share that the new update is nearly complete and will be delivered this month. We can't wait for you to explore the improved world of Fantôme, which includes the new map of the game "Rajbari."

Thank you for your patience and continued support. Stay tuned for more updates!

Best regards,
Fantôme Development Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42673810/4e48157843069e8298ac35d6ab5fc07f8a60cead.jpg[/img]
